spanish: Sobre tortas de pan leudado acercará su ofrenda, sobre sacrificio de agradecimiento de sus pazes.

findings.issue: זֶבַח is absolute, not construct; “sacrificio de agradecimiento” closes it as the head of a genitive the absolute state leaves open.
לֶחֶם חָמֵץ is a construct plus an absolute noun (“bread of leaven”); “pan leudado” turns that noun into an adjective without adding a new referent.
The plural noun with a 3ms suffix is carried by the irregular plural “pazes”; the offering sense of H8002 is only partly visible.

notes: Repeated עַל, the 3ms hiphil, and both possessive suffixes match the tokens.
